decisions.reason: A piqué upholstery fabric close to the core offer that is featured on its own page signals management commitment, and one year is too short to judge it against aspirations, so it stays in the collection.
Only a brief mention online suggests lower priority, but a decorative fabric close to the core range costs little to carry, and with no clear shortfall it is unlikely to trigger problemistic search.
A flame-retardant jacquard serves the contract and hospitality segment where performance textiles are required, has its own page, and fits the firm's functional strategy, so dropping it is unlikely.
The wool-blend double-face fabric supports the shift toward renewable materials, and although it is only mentioned online, collection cycles in interior textiles usually run several years.
A wool bouclé leno fits the sustainability direction and the existing design range, and with no evidence yet of results below aspiration the firm keeps it while sales develop.
